after:
# Rufus build configuration for Just
# Usage: just [target]

# Default compiler
CC := env('CC', 'gcc')

# Parallel jobs (default: number of CPU cores)
JOBS := env('JOBS', '8')

# Build directory (must be project root for configure)
BUILD_DIR := '.'

# Rufus binary location
RUFUS_BIN := 'src/rufus'

# Dependencies (Arch Linux)
deps:
    sudo pacman -S --needed gtk3 libcurl util-linux fontconfig pkgconf

# Configure for Linux
configure:
    ./configure --with-os=linux CC="{{CC}}"

# Clean build artifacts
clean:
    make clean

# Build Rufus
build: configure
    make -j"{{JOBS}}"

# Full rebuild (clean + build)
rebuild: clean build

# Run Rufus (requires build first)
run: build
    ./{{RUFUS_BIN}}

# Run with Wayland backend explicitly
run-wayland: build
    GDK_BACKEND=wayland ./{{RUFUS_BIN}}

# Install system-wide (requires root)
install: build
    sudo cp {{RUFUS_BIN}} /usr/local/bin/rufus

# Show build status
status:
    @echo "Compiler: {{CC}}"
    @echo "Jobs: {{JOBS}}"
    @echo "Binary: {{RUFUS_BIN}}"
    @test -f {{RUFUS_BIN}} && echo "Built: yes" || echo "Built: no"
